# Fixture Docs

This rendered documentation fixture preserves prose through the complete publication pipeline.

- The heading above skips from h1 to h5 and must be renumbered to h2 for a valid outline.

```sh
lines inside code fences are never counted toward text coverage at all
```

A second `install` anchor makes the builder deduplicate IDs. Jump up.

See the [source tree](https://github.com/example/fixture/tree/2440b06/apps/docs/content/guides/getting-started) for a `fixture_sdk.retry_policy` example with defaults.

The accordion title above wraps a paragraph <strong>inside the heading</strong>, which XHTML does not allow.

The client method returns a `Promise<SystemOneResult>` that resolves once the response is parsed.

1. Every heading on this page carries a permalink icon that renders as a block inside the heading's markup.
